prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final game sprite choreography sheet for a native desktop layered companion.
Primary request: draw 8 NEW full-body poses of the exact LEAD adult woman from image 1, also identified as the leftmost character in image 2. Keep her auburn short bob with cream fringe, green eyes, subtle headset, white cropped work jacket with orange small accents, fitted dark teal button shirt, grey high-waist cargo trousers and chunky white/charcoal/orange sneakers. Preserve her established adult height, face, body proportions, outfit and painterly pixel sprite detailing. No chibi.
Composition: strict 4 equal-width columns by 2 equal-height rows, 8 separated full-body silhouettes, with generous true transparent margins (at least 24 px around every silhouette), no crossing between slots. Top row left to right: (1) working with her tablet and stylus, camera right three-quarter front view; (2) right side profile working with tablet; (3) completely back view, work tablet at side; (4) purposeful walking step facing left three-quarter, one foot forward, holding tablet. Bottom row left to right: (5) walking facing right three-quarter with opposite step; (6) down on one knee actively checking her tablet with stylus; (7) leaning forward supporting forearm on a small work table while annotating a tablet; (8) seated on a simple stool at a small desk working on tablet, camera right three-quarter. Tables and stool are minimal neutral charcoal objects only in those specific slots.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent RGBA, empty outside sprites. No floor planes, cast shadows, backgrounds, checkerboard drawing, grid, labels, letters, title, watermark.
Art quality: clean natural dark contour, preserve interior highlight/shadow volume in face and clothing, no bright red/blue/green fringe or isolated color artifacts. Keep entire hair, hands, furniture and feet fully inside each slot. Identity must be recognizably the same adult LEAD across all 8 drawings. Each pose must be newly drawn in its actual camera angle, not a mirrored or squeezed front image.
Input images: image 1 identity and outfit reference; image 2 supporting established identity/style reference.
